item.guhs.vormstaf.lore: Click a block: your shape stands there as a ghost. Sneak-click: that block becomes your material. Hold the Shape Wand key for the menu.
item.guhs.vervangkwast.lore: Repaints blocks into your own block, in the same shape (a stair stays a stair). Sneak-click: pick the block.
item.guhs.mengkwast.lore: A mix of up to four blocks (70/20/10). Sneak-click blocks to add them to the mix.
item.guhs.patroonkwast.lore: Stripes, checkerboard, gradient, little guh faces. Animal patterns open once that animal is in your safari dex.
item.guhs.verweerkwast.lore: Moss, cracks and ivy: makes everything a little old and cosy.
item.guhs.egaliseerder.lore: Flatten, a slope, a pit or pond, or a hill. Works from a Salt Shed.
item.guhs.verfmachine.lore: Recolours wool, concrete and terracotta in one go, even as a rainbow gradient. Works from a Sauce Shed.
item.guhs.tunnelboor.lore: Round, square or vaulted, lined and with little lamps. No mining mode, just a pretty tunnel. From a Sauce Shed.
item.guhs.blauwdruk.lore: Click a block: the design stands there as a ghost. Never runs out.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.gekoppeld: Linked to this shed (%s). Your tool now works at its level!
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.geen_keet: Sneak-click a Building Shed to link (otherwise: handiwork)
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.vanaf: Works from a %s (link it to such a shed)
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.dicht.natuur: Nature shapes come with a Salt Shed, chonk.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.dicht.bloktekst: Block text comes with a Salt Shed, chonk.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.dicht.dex: Photograph this animal in the safari park first (Guhdex), then you may use its pattern!
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.kwast.kies_blok: Pick a block first: sneak-click it with the brush.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.kwast.kies_mix: Pick blocks first: sneak-click them with the brush (up to four).
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.kwast.kies_twee: This pattern needs at least two blocks in the mix.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.kies: Pick a block from your hotbar (or offhand):
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.kies.uitleg: Pick a block from your hotbar. Or sneak-click a block in the world with the tool.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.plaats_spook.uitleg: Puts it in front of the shed's door as the project. Then: move, turn, Build!
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.rond.uitleg: scroll: size · shift: height · ctrl: thickness · H: hollow
gui.guhs.bouwkeet.bezig: The shed is still building. Wait a moment, or pause first.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.uitleg.vormstaf: Click a block to put your shape down as a ghost. Sneak-click a block: wall material.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.uitleg.vervangkwast: Every click repaints a little ball of blocks into your block, in the same shape.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.uitleg.mengkwast: Every click paints a little ball of blocks in your mix (70/20/10).
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.uitleg.patroonkwast: Every click paints a pattern. Animal patterns colour wool, concrete and terracotta.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.uitleg.verweerkwast: Every click makes it old: moss, cracks, ivy.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.uitleg.egaliseerder: Click the ground: the new terrain stands there as a ghost. Look at it, then press Build!
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.uitleg.verfmachine: Click in the middle of your build: all wool, concrete and terracotta around it gets a new colour.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.uitleg.tunnelboor: Click a wall: the tunnel goes the way you look. Sneak-click a block: lining.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.vastleg.hoek1: First corner: %s, %s, %s. Now click the other corner.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.vastleg.uitleg: You see the pink frame in the world. Empty spots inside the building come along.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.vastleg.te_groot: Too big! This level allows up to %s blocks.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.vastleg.leeg: There's nothing in the frame, chonk.
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.vastleg.vol: You already have %s blueprints. Throw one away first (Design Desk).
gui.guhs.bouwhulp.vastleg.bewaard: Blueprint "%s" saved (%s blocks)! You'll find it in the Building Shed and at the Design Desk.
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.leeg.eigen: No own blueprints yet. Set your Shape Wand to Capture and click your nicest build!
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.leeg.bibliotheek: Nothing published on this server yet. Be the first (from a Sauce Shed)!
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.plaats.uitleg: Becomes this shed's project: a ghost in front of the door.
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.print.uitleg: A blueprint to take along (costs a sheet of paper). Click a block with it, anywhere.
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.papier: You need a sheet of paper to print.
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.weg: Throw away (only your own, or as op)
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.kwijt: This blueprint doesn't exist any more. Thrown away?
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.bureau.uitleg: You publish in a Building Shed (from a Sauce Shed).
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.publiceer.uitleg: Publish in the server's library, with your name on it!
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.publiceer.vanaf: Publishing comes with a Sauce Shed (and no bigger than the shed allows).
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.publiceer.te_groot: Too big for this shed: it allows up to %s.
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.publiceer.ok: Published! Everyone on the server can build it now.
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.publiceer.vol: You already have %s in the library. Remove one first.
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.publiceer.al: That one is in the library already, chonk.
gui.guhs.blauwdruk.winkel.uitleg: Build this park building at home: a blueprint you can put down anywhere.
